messages:
Maya (Hiring Manager): Incoming hire (Senior Platform Engineer) joins Mon. I want a one-pager managers can paste that sets a tight first-5-day sprint + clear 30/60/90 success criteria. Any compact template?
Priya (People Ops): Yep — here's a copy-paste manager version. Keep it brief so managers actually send it.
Priya (People Ops): ```Manager copy (paste into welcome calendar + offer acceptance)
Week 0 (preboard)
- Confirm laptop model, MDM, VPN and SSO access. Confirm badge and desk assignment.
- Invite to team Slack channel, add to repo teams, PagerDuty, and monitoring read groups.
- Assign peer buddy and schedule the Day 1 walk-through.

Day 1 (orientation + context)
- 9:00 AM: 30m intro w/ manager (role intent, immediate priorities, and communication norms)
- 10:00 AM: 45m buddy tour (critical dashboards, local dev flow, runbooks)
- 2:00 PM: 30m infra architecture overview w/ senior IC
- EOD: 15m check-in to agree on first-week micro-goal

Days 2-3 (land and contribute)
- Complete access checklist, run the dev/start script, send 1st build PR (tiny change)
- Shadow on-call + update one runbook with steps and links
- Pair session each day with a domain SME (scheduled 1h)

Days 4-5 (deliver & present)
- Complete first small ticket from backlog and open PR
- Present 10-min "what I shipped" at Friday sync
- 30-min manager 1:1 to set next 30-day focus

30/60/90 (manager-facing outcomes)
- 30d: Onboarded to primary repo and infra; 3 small PRs merged, one improved runbook; participates in 2 retros.
- 60d: Leads one incident postmortem or feature rollout; proposes measurable perf/cost change with experiment plan.
- 90d: Independent ownership of a service or infra surface with defined SLIs and a short plan for improvement (measurable objective).

Quick manager 1:1 cadence (copy into recurring invite)
- Week1: daily 15m check-ins (fast blockers)
- Weeks2-4: twice-weekly 30m syncs
- After 30d: weekly 30-60m 1:1

Suggested manager framing sentence for stakeholders:
"By day 90 we expect independent ownership of a core surface with one clear metric improvement and documented handover notes."
```
Lena (Senior IC): Love the micro-goal pattern. Suggest swapping "3 small PRs" to "2 internal + 1 cross-team" for org visibility.
Maya (Hiring Manager): Good call, Lena. I'll adjust. Can we also add the on-call shadowing checklist (what to watch for)?
Priya (People Ops): Added a 3-point on-call shadow checklist in the handbook PR.
Ravi (IT): @Maya Im provisioning the laptop now. Please confirm office (SF / Remote) and if they need a dock. ETA: Friday delivery. :package:

onboard-bot: welcome packet created, calendar template applied, and manager checklist sent to Maya.
Maya (Hiring Manager): Perfect. One more ask: short copy I can paste into the team channel to introduce them on day1.
Priya (People Ops): Copy for Slack intro: 
"Please welcome <@newhire> to Platform! Starts Monday. Buddy: @Lena. First-week micro-goal: ship a small infra config PR and update a runbook. Drop any links that help them ramp."
Lena (Senior IC): I'll plan two pairing sessions (Tue + Thu) and add a walk-through of the deploy pipeline.
Maya (Hiring Manager): Thanks everyone. I'll post the intro and attach the manager copy to the calendar invite.
